villagemaster/32206.htm.text: Grand Master Pieche: You look like you could use some help, my friend... No? Ha ha, oh yes you do! Don't look so surprised! Once you reach my age, you can read the truth in a person's eyes and gestures. Words only confuse the issue... How can I help you?

links.text: Use a shadow weapon exchange coupon.
